context: Yumiko visits her brother Hiroshi-boss alone to talk about their mother — who is now widowed and grieving.
purpose: sister-brother adult coordination — careful family responsibility around grief

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お兄さん、ちょっと、お母さんのこと、話したくて。
lines.en: Big brother, I want to talk about mother.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft sincere careful family-respectful-warm opening, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん、来てくれて良かった。俺もずっと気になってた。
lines.en: Yes, glad you came. I've been worried too.
lines.style: Boss warm soft authority-down brother-warm grateful, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん亡くなってから、一人で家にいるのが、心配で。
lines.en: Since father passed, alone at home — worried.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft sincere honest-vulnerable-warm sharing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。週に何回、誰かが顔出すようにしようか。
lines.en: Yeah. How about someone visits a few times a week?
lines.style: Boss warm soft sincere practical-warm proposing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いい考え。私と亮介で、ちゃんとローテーション組む。
lines.en: Good idea. Ryosuke and I will rotate properly.
lines.style: Maternal warm sincere bright committed-warm planning, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 俺も、週末は必ず行く。家族で支えよう。
lines.en: I'll go weekends without fail. Let's support as family.
lines.style: Boss warm soft sincere committed-warm-extending, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お兄さんがいてくれて、本当に心強い。
lines.en: Having you, big brother — truly reassuring.
lines.style: Maternal warm soft sincere deep grateful-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: こちらこそ。ゆみこがしっかりしてくれてるから。
lines.style: Boss warm soft sincere reciprocal-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
